Ultima - Runes of Virtue II.name: Ultima: Runes of Virtue II
Ultima - Runes of Virtue II.summary: Ultima: Runes of Virtue II is the sequel to Runes of Virtue. It maintains the action-RPG gameplay of the original. In this game, the Black Knight kidnaps Lord Tholden, simply out of boredom. Lord British sends you, the Avatar, out to recover Tholden and return peace to Britannia.
